proposed.text: Per SPP 202 Sec 5.2, how is the MDPE multiplier M defined?

options.text: M is the multiplier to account for overhead and reasonable profit, ranging from 1.5 to 2.5
M is a three-component framework of overhead, profit, and non-technical factors
M is the reimbursable expense added after the fee
M is a fixed statutory multiplier of 3.0 for all projects

proposed.rationale: SPP Document 202, Section 5.2 defines M as the multiplier used to account for overhead and reasonable profit, with a source-backed range of 1.5 to 2.5 and qualitative factors (office setup, overhead, Architect's experience, project complexity). SPP 202 does NOT define a three-component (overhead + profit + non-technical) framework; that framework is an exam trap. Source: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 (https://www.architectureboard.com.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/1.4-2010-SPP-for-PH-Architects.pdf).
proposed.explanation: SPP 202 Sec 5.2 defines M as the overhead-and-reasonable-profit multiplier in the 1.5-2.5 range. Any three-component decomposition is invented.
